title: Lucky Thirteen Original Black Widow Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Black Widow Ice delivers an exquisitely complex rush of perfectly complementary flavours of Blackberry and Aniseed, with an invigorating blast of Menthol on the exhale. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e-liquid's nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
